message: No detected input validation: The code passes the input question string directly into processing functions with only bare try/except blocks for error suppression, but no schema, type, length, or value-range checks on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The model and tokenizer are loaded from a local hardcoded path and the external API call in aryana.py uses plain HTTP with no checksum, signature, or revision pinning to verify integrity of retrieved data.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tooling is present anywhere in the code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to training data in any of the pipeline files shown.

No detected model integrity verification: The model and tokenizer are loaded directly from a local file path using `from_pretrained()` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision specified.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads a pre-trained model (AutoModelForTokenClassification) and runs inference; there is no training loop or label distribution validation anywhere in the pipeline slice.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms are present; the code only loads and uses a pre-trained model without any adversarial defense analysis.

No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are used anywhere in the code; training appears to rely on a pre-trained model without DP protections.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics; the code simply runs inference on a single hardcoded sentence with no evaluation safeguards.

No detected input sanitization: The input string is passed directly to reformat_date_time, reformat_date, and the NER model without any shape, length, type, or content validation; bare except clauses silently swallow errors but do not constitute sanitization.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (token classifications, temperature values, etc.) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before being returned or formatted into the answer.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline uses a transformer NER model (not a generative LLM), there is no input filtering, content moderation, or injection detection applied to the user-supplied text at any point in the inference path.
